ext_description.message: Click a chosen button at an exact server-synced second. Clock sync, element picker, countdown.

sync_none.message: Clock is not synced with the server

sync_status.message: Your clock is $1 from the server (±$2 s, RTT $3 ms)

reload_label.message: Reload the page if button 1 is still disabled after

timing_hint.message: Offset: negative fires earlier, positive later than the exact server time. Reload applies to live and manual mode.

steps_hint.message: When the success text appears on the page the run is over, however many steps remain. Button text can be a regex, e.g. /^yes\b/ matches „Yes" and „Yes, submit". After a click a step counts as done when the expected text, the success text or the next button shows up.

arm_dry.message: Arm DRY RUN at the set time

arm_live.message: Arm LIVE at the set time

arm_manual.message: Arm MANUAL: countdown + focus, you click

actions_hint.message: Manual: at the exact second the panel flashes, beeps and focuses the button, you press Enter or click. Dry run only highlights the buttons. Live clicks for you. Some sites forbid automated submissions, read their terms first. Keep the tab visible and the window focused.

advanced_hint.message: If the expected text does not appear the click is repeated up to the given count. The last step always clicks once.

state_missing_first.message: ● Button is not on the page right now

state_missing_later.message: ○ Button not on the page yet (appears later)

test_not_found.message: Step $1: button not found on the page

keep_one_step.message: At least one step must remain

log_sync_old.message: Using a sync from $1 min ago, a fresh one failed

log_sync_coarse.message: Sync is coarse (±$1 s), the click may land off by that much

how_skipped.message: skipped, appears only after a real click

wake_lock_off.message: Screen wake lock unavailable, do not let the computer sleep

session_lost_log.message: Session expired! Log in again and re-arm.

hand_over.message: NOW! Press Enter or click the focused button

set_opening_time.message: Set the opening date and time

opening_passed.message: The opening time has passed. Use „LIVE now" or set a new time.

no_sync_refuse.message: Clock is not synced with the server, refusing to arm $1. Press Sync and try again.

stale_past.message: Old armed state discarded: the opening time has passed

tab_hidden.message: Tab is not visible! Chrome throttles timers in the background, come back to this tab.

fail_not_found.message: Button „$1" not found or not enabled within $2 ms

fail_no_confirmation.message: After $1 clicks no confirmation (no expected text, no success text, no next button)

fail_button_gone.message: Button „$1" disappeared after the click and no confirmation followed

fail_manual_timeout.message: No confirmation within 90 s that the button was pressed

err_sync_unreachable.message: No probe URL on $1 returned a Date header

pick_banner.message: Click the button to press · Esc to cancel

popup_not_a_site.message: Open a website tab to use Fastest Finger.

popup_not_enabled.message: Not enabled on $1. Enable it and the panel appears on the page.

popup_loading.message: Panel is still loading, refresh the page if it does not appear.

never_click_label.message: Never click buttons whose text matches

alert_text_label.message: Alert while armed when this text appears

safety_hint.message: Plain text or /regex/. The never-click rule applies to every click, including a picked selector. The alert text is meant for session-expired messages.

warn_already_present.message: Step $1: „$2" is already on the page, not using it as confirmation

fail_manual_no_check.message: Nothing left to confirm the click: the expected text, success text and next button are already on the page
